name: Default branch is protected
description: Every active repository protects its default branch from direct and force pushes.
remediation: Protect the default branch, or add a ruleset, so changes arrive through a pull request and force pushes are blocked.

name: Merges need an approving review
description: The default branch requires at least one approving review before a change merges.
remediation: Require one or more approving reviews in branch protection or the pull request ruleset.

name: Merged changes were reviewed
description: Every change merged into the default branch in the last 30 days was approved by someone other than its author.
remediation: Review the listed changes now and record it, then require reviews so a change cannot merge unreviewed again.

name: Checks must pass before merge
description: The default branch requires automated checks to pass before a change merges.
remediation: Add the test job as a required status check on the default branch.

name: Secret scanning is on
description: Every active repository scans new pushes and its history for committed credentials.
remediation: Turn on secret scanning in the repository's security settings.

name: Dependency alerts are on
description: Every active repository raises alerts for dependencies with known vulnerabilities.
remediation: Turn on Dependabot alerts in the repository's security settings.

name: Two factor is required for code access
description: The source control organisation requires every member to use two factor authentication.
remediation: In the organisation's authentication security settings, require two factor authentication for everyone.

name: Code scanning runs on every change
description: Static analysis checks every change for injection and input validation flaws.
remediation: Turn on code scanning for each repository.

name: Stored data is encrypted
description: Every storage bucket, database and volume in scope is encrypted at rest.
remediation: Turn on default encryption with a managed key for each resource.

name: Endpoints require TLS
description: Load balancers and public endpoints accept TLS 1.2 or later only.
remediation: Set a TLS 1.2 minimum security policy on every listener and endpoint.

name: Network rules deny by default
description: Security groups and firewalls allow only the inbound traffic a service needs.
remediation: Remove open inbound rules and allow only named sources and ports.

name: No admin ports open to the internet
description: SSH, RDP and database ports cannot be reached from anywhere on the internet.
remediation: Close the port to the internet and reach it through a bastion or zero trust access.

name: Accounts meet the hardening baseline
description: Cloud configuration passes the CIS foundations benchmark.
remediation: Fix the benchmark items listed on the result.

name: Threat detection is on
description: A managed threat detection service watches every account and region in use.
remediation: Turn on the provider's threat detection service in every region in use.

name: Encryption keys rotate
description: Customer managed encryption keys rotate at least once a year.
remediation: Turn on automatic yearly rotation for each customer managed key.

name: Production is segmented
description: Production workloads run in their own network, with controlled paths between tiers.
remediation: Move production into its own network and restrict traffic between tiers.

name: Secrets live in a vault
description: Application secrets are held in a secrets manager, not in configuration or code.
remediation: Move the secret into the secrets manager and read it at runtime.

name: Backups run and are kept
description: Every production database has automated backups with the retention the policy sets.
remediation: Turn on automated backups and set retention to the policy period.

name: Capacity alarms are set
description: Alarms fire before compute, storage or database capacity runs out.
remediation: Add utilisation alarms that notify the on call rotation.

name: Audit logging is on
description: Every account records administrative activity to protected, retained logs.
remediation: Turn on the audit trail in every region and store it where it cannot be altered.

name: Configuration changes are recorded
description: Changes to cloud configuration are recorded and raise alerts.
remediation: Turn on configuration recording and alert on changes to sensitive settings.

name: Root accounts use two factor
description: Root and break glass accounts have two factor authentication and no access keys.
remediation: Add a hardware or app based second factor to the root account and delete its keys.

name: No broad admin grants
description: No user or role holds wildcard administrator permissions without a recorded need.
remediation: Replace the wildcard policy with the permissions the role uses.

name: Machine credentials rotate
description: Service account keys and access keys are younger than 90 days.
remediation: Rotate the key, or replace it with a short lived role.

name: Environments are separated
description: Production runs in its own account or project, apart from development and staging.
remediation: Move production into a dedicated account or project.

name: Build output keeps versions
description: Buckets and registries that hold build output keep versions and block overwrites.
remediation: Turn on versioning or immutable tags for the store.

name: Data is deleted on schedule
description: Storage lifecycle rules delete data when its retention period ends.
remediation: Add a lifecycle rule that matches the retention schedule.

name: Every system is in the asset register
description: Resources discovered in connected systems all appear in the Verity asset register.
remediation: Add the resource to the asset register, or record why it is out of scope.

name: Two factor is enforced
description: The sign in policy requires two factor for every user, and every active user has enrolled.
remediation: Require two factor in the sign in policy and follow up with users who have not enrolled.

name: Apps sign in through SSO
description: Business applications authenticate through the identity provider.
remediation: Connect the application to single sign on and turn off local passwords.

name: Password policy meets the standard
description: Minimum length, complexity and lockout settings meet the password policy.
remediation: Update the identity provider's password policy to the company standard.

name: Sessions time out
description: Idle and maximum session lengths are set within the policy.
remediation: Set idle and maximum session lengths in the identity provider.

name: Few administrators
description: Administrator roles are held only by named, approved people.
remediation: Remove administrator roles that have no recorded approval.

name: Access lists export for review
description: Current users and their groups export for the periodic access review.
remediation: Connect the identity provider so each review starts from the live user list.

name: Access comes from roles
description: Application access is granted through role groups rather than to individuals.
remediation: Move direct assignments into the role group that should hold them.

name: Connected apps are known
description: Applications granted access through the identity provider are inventoried and approved.
remediation: Approve the application, or revoke its access.

name: Leavers lose access within a day
description: Everyone who left has no active account 24 hours after their last day.
remediation: Suspend the account now and find out why offboarding missed it.

name: Joiners get access through onboarding
description: New starters receive accounts only after their onboarding checklist starts.
remediation: Start the onboarding checklist for the listed people.

name: Everyone uses the company vault
description: Every active employee has a company password manager account.
remediation: Invite the listed people to the company password manager.

name: Changes trace to approved tickets
description: Production changes reference a ticket that was approved before release.
remediation: Link the change to its ticket and record the approval.

name: Access requests are approved
description: New access is granted against an approved request.
remediation: Record the approval for the listed grants, or remove the access.

name: Failures are tracked to closure
description: Control failures and audit findings open a ticket that closes within its SLA.
remediation: Open or update the ticket and agree a date to close it.

name: Security alerts page someone
description: Security alerts route to an on call rotation, not an unread inbox.
remediation: Route the security alert source to an escalation policy.

name: Alerts are acknowledged in time
description: High severity alerts are acknowledged within the response target.
remediation: Review the missed alerts and adjust the rotation or escalation.

name: Incidents close with a timeline
description: Incidents are resolved with an owner and a recorded timeline.
remediation: Add the owner and timeline to the listed incidents.

name: Web traffic is filtered
description: A web application firewall and DDoS protection sit in front of public applications.
remediation: Turn on the managed firewall rules for the zone.

name: Private systems need a trusted device
description: Internal systems are reachable only through the VPN or zero trust network.
remediation: Put the system behind the zero trust network and remove public access.

name: Edge TLS is current
description: The edge accepts TLS 1.2 or later and redirects plain HTTP.
remediation: Raise the zone's minimum TLS version and turn on HTTPS redirects.

name: Logs are kept long enough
description: Application and security logs are retained for the period the policy sets.
remediation: Raise retention to the policy period.

name: Unusual activity raises alerts
description: Monitors alert on error spikes, unusual traffic and failed sign ins.
remediation: Add monitors for the missing signals and route them to on call.

name: Processing failures are caught
description: Jobs and data pipelines alert when processing fails or falls behind.
remediation: Add failure and lag alerts to the listed jobs.

name: Capacity trends are watched
description: Dashboards and monitors track utilisation so capacity is added before it runs out.
remediation: Add utilisation monitors for the listed services.

name: Systems are scanned monthly
description: Every in scope asset was scanned for vulnerabilities in the last 30 days.
remediation: Add the asset to the scan schedule.

name: Laptops are managed
description: Every company laptop is enrolled in device management.
remediation: Enrol the listed laptops.

name: Laptop disks are encrypted
description: Every managed laptop has full disk encryption turned on.
remediation: Turn on FileVault or BitLocker through device management.

name: Screens lock when idle
description: Every managed laptop locks its screen after the idle time the policy sets.
remediation: Push the screen lock profile to the listed laptops.

name: Operating systems are patched
description: Every managed laptop runs a supported, patched operating system.
remediation: Update the listed laptops.

name: Lost laptops can be wiped
description: Every managed laptop can be locked and wiped remotely.
remediation: Re-enrol the listed laptops with remote wipe allowed.

name: Endpoint protection is running
description: Every laptop and server runs a healthy, up to date protection agent.
remediation: Install or repair the agent on the listed devices.
